title: Primer · Feedback: loops that settle, add up, or explode
about: Primer 0.16 (1 of 3): a difference equation makes each value from the last; a feedback loop turns one clap into 1, a, a^2, ...; a loss curve's moving average settles; with a steady input a loop settles, adds up or explodes; too strong a correction flips the error; why the gap to the resting value shrinks by a each step.
